risk_if_not_implemented: Without Fail Safe, security may be bolted on rather than designed in, resulting in structural weaknesses that are costly to remediate and easy to exploit. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, no risk is rated Likely; risks rated Possible include Business / Service Interruption (R-BC-1), System / Data Compromise (Technical Vector) (R-BC-4), System / Service Compromise (R-EX-7), and most likely increases susceptibility to Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Predictable Failure Analysis
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to determine the Mean Time to Failure (MTTF) for system components in specific environments of operation.
compensating_control_1.justification: Predictable Failure Analysis (AST-40) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Fail Safe (SEA-16) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Business Continuity Management System (BCMS)
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to operate a Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) to achieve resilient Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) during:
(1) Routine operations; and
(2) Adverse conditions.
compensating_control_2.justification: Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) (BCD-02) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Fail Safe (SEA-16) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
